enable_animation.label: Enable Animation
enable_animation.description: Here you can enable animation for highlighter.

anim_start.label: Animation Start
anim_start.description: Define when the animation will start.

anim_start_viewport.label: Viewport Bottom Offset
anim_start_viewport.description: Here you can specifies the animation start position on viewport from bottom.

anim_easing.label: Easing
anim_easing.description: Define when the animation will start.

anim_duration.label: Duration
anim_duration.description: Here you can define duration for animation by ms.

anim_delay.label: Delay
anim_delay.description: Here you can define a delay for the start of an animation ms.

enable_loop.label: Loop
enable_loop.description: Here you can enable animation for infinite times.

anim_iteration.label: Iteration
anim_iteration.description: Here you can specifies the number of times an animation should be played.

anim_iteration_gap.label: Iteration Gap
anim_iteration_gap.description: Here you can define a delay between each iteration by ms. This options will work if iteration more than one.

highlighter_color.label: Color
highlighter_color.description: Here you can define a custom color for highlighter stroke.

enable_gradient_color.label: Use Gradient Color
enable_gradient_color.description: Here you can set gradient color for highlighter stroke.

gradient_color_start.label: Start Color
gradient_color_start.description: Here you can define start gradient color for highlighter stroke.

gradient_color_end.label: End Color
gradient_color_end.description: Here you can define end gradient color for highlighter stroke.

gradient_type.label: Gradient Type
gradient_type.description: Here you can set gradient type.

gradient_direction.label: Gradient Direction
gradient_direction.description: Here you can specify both color angle value.

gradient_direction_radial.label: Radial Direction
gradient_direction_radial.description: Here you can specify both color radial position value..

gradient_start_position.label: Start position
gradient_start_position.description: Here you can specify the start position of the first gradient color.

gradient_end_position.label: End position
gradient_end_position.description: Here you can specify the end position of the first gradient color.

highlighter_stroke_width.label: Stroke Width
highlighter_stroke_width.description: Here you can define stroke width for highlighter element.

highlighter_size.label: Size (by scale)
highlighter_size.description: Here you can define a custom size for highlighter element by scale. The amount of scaling is defined by a vector [sx, sy], it can resize the horizontal and vertical dimensions at different scales.

highlighter_opacity.label: Opacity
highlighter_opacity.description: Here you can set the opacity level for highlighter element.

highlighter_position.label: Position
highlighter_position.description: Select whether the highlighter element is above or below the text.

highlighter_vertical_position.label: Vertical Offset
highlighter_vertical_position.description: Here you can define vertical offset of highlighter element.

highlighter_horizontal_position.label: Horizontal Offset
highlighter_horizontal_position.description: Here you can define horizontal offset of highlighter element.
